source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'IP Addressing and Subnetting' (PDF 15): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: IP address ek unique (sirf usi ka) number hai jo kisi device ko assign (diya) kiya jata hai. IP ka matlab hai Internet Protocol. Yeh network par devices ki pehchan mein madad deta hai. Data apni destination (manzil) dhoondne ke liye IP addresses istemal karta hai. Har network device ka IP address hona zaroori hai. Is ke baghair communication (baat-cheet) mumkin nahi.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: IP address ghar ke pate jaisa hai: pata na ho to daakiya chitthi nahi pohancha sakta, aur network data nahi pohancha sakta.

blocks.explanation: Is se network par har device ki pehchan hoti hai aur data apni manzil dhoondta hai; is ke baghair baat-cheet mumkin nahi.

items: IP address: device ka unique number; pehchan aur data ki manzil; har device ke liye zaroori.
